resources.string: 4GForce
Force 4G network
This app takes you directly to Android\'s hidden radio menu, where you can force your phone to use only the 4G (LTE) network.
How it works
1. Tap the button below to open the radio menu.
2. Look for \"Set Preferred Network Type\".
3. Select \"LTE Only\".
4. Done. Your phone will now only use the 4G network.
⚠️ Before you change
No calls or SMS. With LTE Only enabled, your phone cannot make or receive calls or text messages. Calls use 2G/3G on most phones.
Write down your current network type before changing it. It usually appears as \"LTE/TD-SCDMA/UMTS\" or \"LTE/TD-SCDMA/WCDMA\". You\'ll need it to go back to normal.
To restore, go back to this menu and select the original network type you wrote down.
Network modes
Tap to expand
Tap to collapse
• LTE/WCDMA/GSM (auto)\nFull automatic mode. The phone chooses the best available network. Prioritizes LTE, then 3G, then 2G. This is the default mode.
• LTE/WCDMA\n4G and 3G only. The phone never drops to 2G.
• LTE Only\n4G only. The phone only connects to LTE. It does not use 3G or 2G under any circumstances.
• WCDMA/GSM (auto)\n3G and 2G only. Does not use LTE. Useful if LTE has issues in your area.
• WCDMA Only\n3G only. Only uses UMTS/HSPA. Does not use LTE or 2G.
• GSM Only\n2G only. Only uses GSM/EDGE. Very low speeds but maximum coverage and battery savings.
• LTE/TD-SCDMA/UMTS\n4G/3G with TD-SCDMA support. Common on phones sold in China.
• LTE/TD-SCDMA/WCDMA/GSM\nAutomatic mode that includes all technologies, including TD-SCDMA.
